articles.title: SoftBank agrees to acquire Robotics and AI Institute
articles.summary: SoftBank Group has agreed to acquire the Robotics and AI Institute from Hyundai Motor Group, according to multiple sources, with the deal currently under CFIUS review. The institute focuses on robotics AI research across control, perception, manipulation, navigation, and complex physical tasks, and could complement SoftBank’s planned $5.3 billion acquisition of ABB’s robotics business.
